headline: Public hearings on car wash at 101 Elm Street and special permit at 220 Moody Street; $64,600 for Lake Street Fire Station roof.
summary: The council will hold public hearings on a car wash modification at 101 Elm Street and a special permit at 220 Moody Street. It will also consider Mayor requests for funding, license renewals, finance and ordinance items, and recessed hearings.
